r15-mopbook.title: A MOP notebook like Notepad++, and bringing your MOP files in
body: You write MOPs in Notepad++ today. A MOP in Shiftbook is a note for now, so this turns it into a **MOP notebook**: plain text you type freely, line numbers, a tab for each open MOP, Find, and a light colour on headings, numbered steps, Verify lines, Rollback and `[[blanks]]` so the shape shows without forcing a form on you. It floats like the notepad windows and minimises to the bottom bar.

Below are three ways to hold it (**A**, **B**, **C**), then dragging your existing MOP files in, and **Use as template**. Everything you add is kept inside Shiftbook's encrypted file unless you pick the linked folder.
bullets: **Run it** (the step-by-step checklist from round 7) and **Save as file…** (back to .txt for sharing) sit on the notebook's toolbar.
**Templates:** right-click a MOP → **Use as template**. **New MOP from this template** copies it and asks for each `[[blank]]`, replaced everywhere. Blanks left empty stay highlighted.
**Dropping files in:** drag .txt (or .md, .log, .docx) files onto Shiftbook, check the list, press Add. Each one becomes a MOP or a template; the original files aren't touched.
**Linking a folder** instead keeps the files where they are, readable by anyone on the computer and outside Shiftbook's backups, which is why copying in is the recommended one.

figures.caption: A · Notepad++-style window with tabs. Type in it, then press – to tuck it into the bottom bar and click the bar to bring it back.
B · The same window with a map down the side, built from your headings and steps. Click a line to jump.
C · Docked to the right edge. Click the MOPs tab to slide it in and out.
Dragging MOP files in, or linking your MOP folder. Press Show the drop.
Use as template, then fill in the blanks for a new MOP. Type in the boxes.

questions.legend: How should the MOP notebook sit?

options.why: Closest to Notepad++, and it minimises like the notepads you already have.

options.value: B · A, plus the map down the side
options.why: Handy for long MOPs; the map can be hidden.

options.value: C · Docked to the right edge
Drag and drop to copy them in
options.why: They end up encrypted and in backups, like everything else.

options.value: Copy in, and also link my MOP folder
Use as template, with [[blanks]] to fill in
Use as template, just a plain copy

questions.placeholder: e.g. what file types your MOPs are, or how you mark blanks today (XXX, <name>…)

r15-mopbook.pick: A, copy in with drag and drop, and templates with [[blanks]]. If your MOPs already mark blanks another way (XXX, <CHANGE>), tell me and I'll match it.
